note: The status every declared eval suite carried when this ceiling was recorded. Registry validation fails when a suite recorded ready is downgraded to not_applicable, when a recorded suite disappears from the registry, or when the registry declares a suite this file does not record. Raising a suite from not_applicable to ready never fails validation; lowering this ceiling afterwards is optional and manual. Editing this file is the only sanctioned way to record a downgrade, so a deliberate one leaves a reviewable diff and a silent one turns validation red.
claim_note: A ready status here means the suite declares an executable command, not that the command proves the property the suite is named after. 3 of the 27 recorded suites are ready and all three shell out to the same Rust workspace.
